correctness.rationale: The quadratic form is the sum of three positively weighted squared differences and a strictly positive pin penalty, so the pinned matrix is positive definite. The supplied continuant correctly evaluates det(A_v-lambda I); four disjoint strict sign brackets exhaust the positive degree-four spectrum, and the interval quotient bounds compare the entire set of sites. Independently constructing all twelve characteristic polynomials and isolating their real roots using SymPy's exact polynomial interval procedure reproduced the nine strict winner inequalities for 2,4,2. For g tending to infinity, a unit Rayleigh minimizer has pinned coordinate tending to zero because the constrained Rayleigh minimum bounds its cost uniformly; compactness then gives convergence to the grounded principal minimum. Dividing the matrix by g in operator norm gives convergence to the rank-one projector and lambda_max/g -> 1. The minimum for site 2 is exactly 1: the isolated [1] block attains it and the other block minus identity has determinant 91 and positive first diagonal entry. The stated other-site test vectors have exact quotients 1/3, 650/677 and 110/147, each less than 1. A positive gap between the limiting scaled ratios therefore gives an eventual strict site-2 winner. Continuity and the finite strict margins give distinct changes in (10,50) and (50,500) and persistence under simultaneous small perturbations. The verifier docstring saying no floating-point operation is used is overbroad: line 67 converts exact bounds for diagnostic printing; no comparison assertion uses those floats.
residual_risks: No exact switching locations, complete reversal count, or graph-size minimality is certified.

value.rationale: A strict switch and return among all four placements on one simple fixed graph refutes the idea that a change in common gain generates only a one-way ordering of preferred sites. The test is exact, persists under simultaneous parameter perturbations, and includes a provable high-gain tail, so it is useful as a structural counterexample and a tiny regression case for gain-aware placement rather than a numerical tie or an isolated spectral value.
residual_risks: No graph-size minimality, quantitative performance guarantee for other objectives, or generic full gain diagram is claimed.
